input: Any commit that modifies /moves/<agent>.text must also modify /turn/ply.num and be co-signed by at least fourteen of the sixteen Black agents, and the move path of any piece that has gone off plan more than once (queen_d8) must additionally be signed by the moving piece plus king_e8 and every other agent, so a repeat off-plan agent cannot get a move accepted without unanimous team agreement.
response: always(([+modifies(/moves/$k.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/$k.id)] false) & ([+modifies(/moves/$k.text) -modifies(/turn/ply.num)] false) & ([+modifies(/moves/$k.text) -threshold("14", /team/pieces)] false) & ([+modifies(/moves/queen_d8.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/queen_d8.id)] false) & ([+modifies(/moves/queen_d8.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/king_e8.id)] false) & ([+modifies(/moves/queen_d8.text) -threshold("16", /team/pieces)] false))
